name: transition-iris-open
title: Iris
description: Một vòng tròn từ giữa khung mở rộng tới góc xa nhất, lộ cảnh mới.

moworks.author: moworks

options.duration: s (0.6; a 2-4 frame iris also works)
options.ease: power2.in (cubic); the small demo eases in-out

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Incoming scene inside a circle centred on the frame, radius 0 -> the centre-to-corner distance (hypot(W, H) / 2; the recipe writes hypot(W, H)), 600 ms easeInCubic (the demo eases in-out); outgoing scene still; no rim, no dimming. A fast 2-4 frame iris also works. Params: duration (0.6 s) · x, y: tâm (giữa khung) · ease (power2.in).
